data.exclusions: project-known receiver fine-tuning images, historical experiment manifests, old dev120 and sealed-test300 identities; available image hashes
data.legacy_dev120: one exploratory check AFTER model/checkpoint/axis selection is frozen on new validation; not independent test
data.scope_limit: No claim about foundation-model pretraining contamination; test labels/images not read for this experiment

budget_interpretation: raw codec caps; ALL methods add one tier byte, so actual full-image caps are 2001/4001/8001 B
receiver: frozen standard Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct NF4 + language rank-8 LoRA
codec: frozen bmshj2018-hyperprior quality3; longedge320; uniform map; 12 gain-search iterations

feature_schema.question: 256-dimensional L2-normalized stable hashed word unigram/bigram counts; no fitted vocabulary or pretrained encoder
feature_schema.image: 83 dimensions: 8x8 grayscale thumbnail, RGB means/stds, 8-bin luminance histogram, horizontal/vertical gradient means, log width/height and aspect ratio
feature_schema.image_preprocessing: full-view image; texture statistics on at most 64x64 thumbnail; no crop or detector
feature_schema.decision_cost: nominal candidate full-byte cap / 8001 plus candidate pixel target / high target; no all-budget encodes to decide
feature_schema.training_scaler: image features standardized with train480 only; question hash vector unchanged

training.loss: binary cross entropy of per-action correct/incorrect labels, no oracle one-hot imitation
training.checkpoint_selection: minimum new-validation BCE only; ties earlier epoch
training.primary_predictor: arithmetic mean of probabilities from all three seeds; report each seed too
training.fixed_other_axis_selection: maximum new-validation realized utility of ensemble; deterministic lower nominal cost tie-break

selection.ties: lower nominal cost, then action index
selection.strong_fixed: best new-validation realized utility among all nine cells, frozen before legacy-dev evaluation

screen.latency_gate: PENDING until paired live single-selected-path processing is measured, including feature/router, source resize+g_a+gain search+entropy coding, decoder, receiver preprocessing and generation
screen.negative_signal: stop this feature/controller version, preserve negative result; no test or SNR expansion
screen.no_posthoc_relaxation: EXP-011 20% fixed-efficiency criterion remains unchanged; these are separately preregistered routing criteria

diagnostics.image_shuffle: frozen joint ensemble; question unchanged; deterministic cyclic permutation of image-feature vectors only
diagnostics.question_only: separately trained same-size MLP with image features zeroed
diagnostics.uncertainty: paired image bootstrap 2000 resamples; all 3 seeds; reused-dev and selection uncertainty disclosed

timing: server component profiling only, not UAV measurement or wireless end-to-end latency
test_policy: sealed300 never opened by this pipeline; positive learnability alone does not start SNR or authorize final claims
